POWER PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Power Purchase Agreement is entered into as of February 9, 2026 between Prairie Sun Energy LLC ("Seller") and Calder Community College ("Buyer").

1. Energy. Seller will sell Buyer electricity from its solar project near the campus, and Buyer will buy it.

2. Cooperation. The parties will cooperate on permits and on connecting the project to the campus.

3. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Kansas.

PRAIRIE SUN ENERGY LLC
